name: Greco di Tufo
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

notes: Greco di Tufo is a straw-yellow white that is fresh, dry and harmonious, with intense, fine aromas.
Big swings between day and night in its volcanic clay and limestone hills help the grapes keep their acidity.
A sparkling version is also made, from extra brut to extra dry.

blurb.text: A Campania DOCG for still and sparkling wine made from Greco, with Coda di Volpe also allowed.
